notes.title: AnimVR Update - 10.02.01
notes.content:
[b]This update includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] General bug fixes
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]360 rendering[/b] 
[*] Added precision move based on grip pressure 
[*] Added a [b]comfort mode[/b] 
[*] Force precise frame timing when exporting video at stage framerate 
[*] [b]Alembic vertex animation[/b] import (Quill alembic animation support!)
[/list]

The comfort mode was requested by a few users to reduce motion sickness when navigating large scenes. It can be enabled in the "Stage Settings" menu.

You can now import vertex animation from Alembic files. This has the side effect that exports from software like Quill can be imported and played back in AnimVR!

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/CelebratedDefiantAppaloosa.gif[/img]
[i]Animation by [url=https://twitter.com/nicktheladd]Nick Ladd[/url][/i]

We have also made changes that possibly fix the crash-on-startup that a few of you have been experiencing. If you are affected by that, we'd really appreciate it if you could give this update a try!
